_comment: Epoxy — Universal free-tier LLM key rotation proxy. Pools Groq, Ollama Cloud, and Mistral API keys behind a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Drop-in for Open WebUI, AnythingLLM, LM Studio, LibreChat, bots, and any OpenAI SDK client.
name: Epoxy
author: epoxy@users.noreply.github.com
description:
Epoxy pools free-tier API keys from Groq, Ollama Cloud, and Mistral behind a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint with automatic key rotation and cooldown handling.

Works as a drop-in base URL for any OpenAI-compatible client: Open WebUI, AnythingLLM, LM Studio, LibreChat, Discord bots, Python/Node SDKs, and more.

API keys are stored in /home/container/.env. After creating the server, go to the File Manager, open .env, and paste your comma-separated API keys for any of the three providers.

Point any OpenAI-compatible client at this proxy:
  base_url: http://<server-ip>:{{SERVER_PORT}}/v1
  api_key: (any string — auth is not enforced)

Models:
  groq-llama-3.1-8b-instant
  ollama-deepseek-v4-flash:cloud
  ollama-minimax-m3:cloud
  mistral-large-latest

Pool strategies (GROQ_POOL_STRATEGY, OLLAMA_POOL_STRATEGY, MISTRAL_POOL_STRATEGY):
  fill_first / round_robin / least_used / random

Cooldowns: 429→1h, 402→24h, 401→immediate removal

installation.script:
set -x
set -e

apk add --no-cache curl

# fetch source zip from main branch (no release workflow anymore)
URL="https://github.com/instax-dutta/epoxy/archive/refs/heads/main.zip"

curl -sL "$URL" -o /tmp/epoxy.zip
unzip -o /tmp/epoxy.zip -d /tmp/epoxy-extract/

# find and copy the files
if [ -d /tmp/epoxy-extract/epoxy-main ]; then
  SRC=/tmp/epoxy-extract/epoxy-main
else
  SRC=$(find /tmp/epoxy-extract -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | head -1)
fi

cp "$SRC/server.py" /mnt/server/
cp "$SRC/entrypoint.sh" /mnt/server/
cp "$SRC/.env.example" /mnt/server/
cp "$SRC/requirements.txt" /mnt/server/
chmod +x /mnt/server/entrypoint.sh

echo "Epoxy installed from main branch."
